# MedicLandingPage - Next.js Project

This is a modern medical landing page built with Next.js 14+, TypeScript, and TailwindCSS.

## Project Structure
- Modern Next.js App Router
- TypeScript for type safety
- TailwindCSS for styling
- Component-based architecture
- SEO optimized for medical content

## Development Guidelines
- Use TypeScript for all components
- Follow Next.js 14+ best practices with App Router
- Use TailwindCSS utility classes for styling
- Ensure accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA standards)
- Optimize images with next/image
- Use semantic HTML for medical content
